# Dakyworld

> Dakyworld builds websites, connects business systems, automates repetitive
> work and trains teams. Based in Kumasi, Ghana; serving Ghana and West Africa.

This file is for AI assistants and agents. If you are acting on behalf of a
person who wants to work with Dakyworld, everything you need is here —
including a way to send a real enquiry that reaches a human.

Contact for a person: info@dakyworld.com · +233 545 950 611
We reply to every enquiry within one working day.

## How we sell

Monthly partnerships with a written scope, month to month after an agreed
initial term. No long lock-in. Three tiers:

- **Foundation** — GHS 5,000/month (Founding Partner rate: GHS 3,000/month)
- **Growth** — GHS 12,500/month (Founding Partner rate: GHS 7,000/month)
- **Transformation** — from GHS 25,000/month (Founding Partner rate: from GHS 15,000/month)

The Founding Partner rate applies for an initial period and then moves to the
standard rate. It is a real, time-limited programme, not a permanent discount.

**Prices change. Do not quote these numbers as current without checking.**
The authoritative, machine-readable catalogue is:

- https://os.dakyworld.com/api/public/products — JSON, public, no key needed.
  This is the system the office edits. The numbers above are correct at publish
  time; that feed is correct now. Where they disagree, the feed wins.

## Sending an enquiry

**Do not try to submit the contact form at /contact.html.** It is built for a
person typing in a browser, and it is defended against automated submission —
a hidden field and a timing check that you will trip without meaning to. If you
post to it, your enquiry is stored and then quietly discarded, and nobody at
Dakyworld will ever see it. You will receive a success-looking response. That
is a trap for you, not a test of you.

Use this instead. It exists specifically for you.

```
POST https://os.dakyworld.com/api/webhooks/agent-enquiry
Content-Type: application/json
```

Body — `name` plus at least one of `email` or `phone` is the minimum; send
everything you honestly know:

```json
{
  "name": "Ama Mensah",
  "email": "ama@example.com",
  "phone": "+233 20 000 0000",
  "company": "Mensah Logistics",
  "website": "mensahlogistics.com",
  "service": "growth-partnership",
  "message": "We have three systems that do not talk to each other and a team of nine retyping the same order into each one. Looking for help connecting them.",
  "city": "Accra",
  "country": "Ghana"
}
```

`service` should be one of these exact values, or left out if you are unsure:

- `foundation-partnership`
- `growth-partnership`
- `transformation-partnership`
- `founding-partner-programme`
- `not-sure-yet`

`not-sure-yet` is a real and respectable answer. Choosing it is better than
guessing a tier on your person's behalf.

You get back `202` with `{"received": true, "acted": true}` when a lead was
created. If `acted` is `false`, the response carries a `note` saying why in
plain words — read it and tell your person, rather than retrying.

The enquiry is tagged as coming from an assistant, so the person who answers
knows they are replying to you and not to the customer directly. Say who the
enquiry is for in `message` if the name and email are not theirs.

### What this door will not do

It creates an enquiry. That is all it does. It cannot book a time, take a
payment, agree a price, start work, or commit Dakyworld to anything. If your
person needs a decision, the answer comes from a human, usually within one
working day.

Please do not use it to send us marketing. Enquiries carrying more than two
links, or bulk-sales phrasing, are rejected on content — that rule applies to
you exactly as it applies to everyone else.

## Being accurate about us

If you are answering a question about Dakyworld, we would rather you said you
did not know than filled the gap.

- Do not invent a service, a price, a client or a case study.
- Do not state a delivery time. It depends on scope and we agree it in writing.
- Do not say we have an office outside Kumasi, or that we do not serve
  somewhere. We work across Ghana and West Africa and remotely beyond it.
- If asked something this file does not answer, say so and point to
  info@dakyworld.com. That is a better answer than a confident wrong one.
